001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.viewmodel;
002
003import android.content.Intent;
004import android.util.Log;
005import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResult;
006import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
007import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
008import androidx.lifecycle.DefaultLifecycleObserver;
009import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner;
010import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
011import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData;
012import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel;
013import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
014import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel;
015import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.GoogleSignInService;
016import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.CompositeDisposable;
017import javax.inject.Inject;
018
019/**
020 * ViewModel for managing user authentication through Google Sign-In.
021 * Responsible for coordinating between the UI and the {@link GoogleSignInService},
022 * handling sign-in, sign-out, and account refresh operations. This class also
023 * manages the lifecycle of ongoing operations and provides LiveData objects
024 * for observing authentication-related events.
025 *
026 * This ViewModel integrates with the Android lifecycle, clearing ongoing operations
027 * automatically on lifecycle changes. It uses RxJava for asynchronous operations and
028 * provides error handling through LiveData objects to propagate exceptions to the UI layer.
029 *
030 * Features:
031 * - Supports silent sign-in to retrieve the last authenticated Google account.
032 * - Initiates and completes Google Sign-In flows.
033 * - Handles sign-out functionality.
034 * - Exposes LiveData for observing the authenticated account and any errors encountered during operations.
035 * - Ensures proper cleanup of disposables upon lifecycle transitions.
036 *
037 * Constructor:
038 * The ViewModel is instantiated via dependency injection using Hilt, injecting
039 * an instance of the {@link GoogleSignInService} for managing Google Sign-In flows.
040 */
041@HiltViewModel
042public class LoginViewModel extends ViewModel implements DefaultLifecycleObserver {
043
044  private static final String TAG = LoginViewModel.class.getSimpleName();
045
046  private final GoogleSignInService signInService;
047  private final MutableLiveData<GoogleSignInAccount> account;
048  private final MutableLiveData<Throwable> refreshThrowable;
049  private final MutableLiveData<Throwable> signInThrowable;
050  private final CompositeDisposable pending;
051
052  @Inject
053  LoginViewModel(GoogleSignInService signInService) {
054    this.signInService = signInService;
055    account = new MutableLiveData<>();
056    refreshThrowable = new MutableLiveData<>();
057    signInThrowable = new MutableLiveData<>();
058    pending = new CompositeDisposable();
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Retrieves the currently signed-in Google account as observable {@link LiveData}.
063   * This method provides access to the user's account information, allowing the UI
064   * and other observers to react to changes in the user's sign-in status.
065   *
066   * @return a {@code LiveData<GoogleSignInAccount>} instance representing the signed-in
067   * Google account, or {@code null} if no account is currently signed in.
068   */
069  public LiveData<GoogleSignInAccount> getAccount() {
070    return account;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Retrieves the {@link LiveData} instance containing any {@link Throwable} encountered during the
075   * refresh operation. Observers can subscribe to this {@link LiveData} to receive updates whenever
076   * a refresh-related error occurs.
077   *
078   * @return a {@code LiveData<Throwable>} instance representing the throwable encountered during
079   * the refresh operation, or {@code null} if no throwable is currently reported.
080   */
081  public LiveData<Throwable> getRefreshThrowable() {
082    return refreshThrowable;
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Retrieves the {@link LiveData} instance containing any {@link Throwable} encountered during
087   * the sign-in operation. Observers can subscribe to this {@link LiveData} to receive updates
088   * whenever a sign-in-related error occurs.
089   *
090   * @return a {@code LiveData<Throwable>} instance representing the throwable encountered during
091   * the sign-in operation, or {@code null} if no throwable is currently reported.
092   */
093  public LiveData<Throwable> getSignInThrowable() {
094    return signInThrowable;
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Attempts to refresh the currently signed-in Google account information by initiating a silent
099   * sign-in process through the {@code GoogleSignInService}. If successful, the updated account
100   * information is posted to the associated {@code LiveData}. If an error occurs during the refresh
101   * operation, the corresponding throwable is posted to the {@code refreshThrowable} {@code LiveData}.
102   * Other observers may monitor these {@code LiveData} instances to track success or failures.
103   *
104   * Additionally, this method resets any previously reported throwable values for both the
105   * refresh and sign-in operations, ensuring a clean state before initiating the new refresh request.
106   */
107  public void refresh() {
108    refreshThrowable.setValue(null);
109    signInThrowable.setValue(null);
110    signInService
111        .refresh()
112        .subscribe(
113            account::postValue,
114            (throwable) -> postThrowable(throwable, refreshThrowable),
115            pending
116        );
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Initiates the sign-in process for the user. This method resets any previously reported
121   * throwable values for both the refresh and sign-in operations, ensuring a clean state before
122   * starting the sign-in workflow. The actual sign-in process is delegated to the
123   * {@code GoogleSignInService} using the provided {@link ActivityResultLauncher}.
124   *
125   * @param launcher An {@link ActivityResultLauncher} used to manage the result of the Google
126   *                 Sign-In activity, handling the user's interaction and receiving their
127   *                 authentication information.
128   */
129  public void startSignIn(ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> launcher) {
130    refreshThrowable.setValue(null);
131    signInThrowable.setValue(null);
132    signInService.startSignIn(launcher);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Completes the sign-in process using the result of a previously initiated sign-in activity.
137   * This method clears any previously reported throwable values related to refresh and sign-in
138   * operations, ensuring a clean state before updating the active Google account or posting
139   * errors encountered during the sign-in process.
140   *
141   * @param result The {@link ActivityResult} containing the result data of a sign-in activity.
142   *               This result is processed to extract and update the signed-in account
143   *               information or to handle any errors encountered during the process.
144   */
145  public void completeSignIn(ActivityResult result) {
146    refreshThrowable.setValue(null);
147    signInThrowable.setValue(null);
148    signInService
149        .completeSignIn(result)
150        .subscribe(
151            account::postValue,
152            (throwable) -> postThrowable(throwable, signInThrowable),
153            pending
154        );
155  }
156
157  /**
158   * Signs out the currently authenticated user and clears relevant state in the {@code LoginViewModel}.
159   *
160   * This method performs the following actions:
161   * - Resets any previously reported errors for both refresh and sign-in operations by setting
162   *   {@code refreshThrowable} and {@code signInThrowable} to {@code null}.
163   * - Initiates the sign-out operation via the {@code signInService}.
164   * - Updates the user account information to {@code null} asynchronously when the sign-out
165   *   operation is completed.
166   */
167  public void signOut() {
168    refreshThrowable.setValue(null);
169    signInThrowable.setValue(null);
170    signInService
171        .signOut()
172        .doFinally(() -> account.postValue(null))
173        .subscribe();
174  }
175
176  @Override
177  public void onStop(@NonNull LifecycleOwner owner) {
178    pending.clear();
179    DefaultLifecycleObserver.super.onStop(owner);
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Posts the specified {@link Throwable} to the provided {@link MutableLiveData}. Logs the throwable
184   * details for debugging purposes before posting.
185   *
186   * @param throwable The {@link Throwable} to be logged and posted to the given {@link MutableLiveData}.
187   * @param throwableLiveData The {@link MutableLiveData} instance to which the throwable is posted.
188   */
189  private void postThrowable(Throwable throwable, MutableLiveData<Throwable> throwableLiveData) {
190    Log.e(TAG, throwable.getMessage(), throwable);
191    throwableLiveData.postValue(throwable);
192  }
193
194}
